model.name: gpu9_max512_chat
model.description: Biggest-possible 1660 Ti 6GB chat model at T=512. C=768 L=12 H=12 (hd=64), ~86M params, est ~3.2GB of the 5GB process budget with grad checkpointing. BPE-2000 English + chat/tool mix. Fresh weights; never --resume another arch.

metadata.description: 36h budget ~= 9400 optimizer steps x 8192 tokens (B=2, accum=8, T=512) ~= 77M tokens. Pass --steps 9400 as the cosine length. Stride 256 halves window overlap so limited steps see more unique text. Probe with tools/n50_probe.py; chat with interactive.py --chat or tools/assistant_tools.py.
